title: The lot, full
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday. The college's first day. Lot C full for the first time since May. Wood's spot taken. He parks in the wrong lot on purpose, the way he did in '99. Nobody taps. The guard isn't back yet. He misses being tapped.

panels.composition: Lot C, full, the first day of term, students everywhere, every space. The Datsun circling.

image.prompt: a full college parking lot on the first day of term with students crossing everywhere and a small car circling, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD parking in the wrong lot — VISITOR — on purpose. BARNABY on the box.

image.prompt: a young man parking a small car in a space marked for visitors, a small dog on a box in the back seat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood in the car, waiting. Looking at the window for a tap. Nothing.

image.prompt: a young man sitting in a parked car glancing at the side window as if expecting a knock, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The lot. The car in the wrong space. No guard. Wood getting out. He misses being told. The strip gives the window a tap it didn't get: a small mark on the glass, drawn.

image.prompt: a young man getting out of a small car parked in a visitor space, a tiny mark drawn on the car's window where a knock would land, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The wrong lot on purpose. No tap. The strip draws the tap it didn't get.
